definitions.name: cw721_msg_ConfigResponse_cw721_svg_state_SvgCollectionMetadata_
definitions.description: This is a wrapper around CollectionInfo that includes the extension.

owner.description:
The contract's current owner.
`None` if the ownership has been renounced.

pending_expiry.description:
The deadline for the pending owner to accept the ownership.
`None` if there isn't a pending ownership transfer, or if a transfer
exists and it doesn't have a deadline.

pending_owner.description:
The account who has been proposed to take over the ownership.
`None` if there isn't a pending ownership transfer.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_addresses_Addr
definitions.description:
A human-readable address.

In Cosmos, this is typically bech32 encoded. But for multichain smart contracts no
assumptions should be made other than being UTF-8 encoded and of reasonable length.

This type represents a validated address. It can be created in the following ways
1. Use `Addr::unchecked(input)`
2. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_validate(input)?`
3. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_humanize(canonical_addr)?`
4. Deserialize from JSON. This must only be done from JSON that was validated before
such as a contract's state. `Addr` must not be used in messages sent by the user
because this would result in unvalidated instances.

This type is immutable. If you really need to mutate it (Really? Are you sure?), create
a mutable copy using `let mut mutable = Addr::to_string()` and operate on that `String`
instance.

definitions.name: cw_utils_expiration_Expiration
definitions.description:
Expiration represents a point in time when some event happens.
It can compare with a BlockInfo and will return is_expired() == true
once the condition is hit (and for every block in the future)

never.description: Never will never expire. Used to express the empty variant

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_timestamp_Timestamp

mint_start_time.description: Timestamp of mint start. If less than current block, mints available

packed.description:
SVP1-packed template + variables (`cw-svg-pack`). Required on create.
Stored once under its own key; empty in stored config / collection info.

price_tiers.description: Price tiers for minting. Empty or None = free mint.

require_auth.description:
When true, every mint must include valid ADR-36 `ext` auth
(`CosmosArbitrary` over DST+nonce[|digest]). Required for trustless
pledge collections; default false preserves open-mint SVG drops.

whitelist.description: Optional merkle whitelist contract address. Whitelisted minters bypass fees.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: cw721_svg_contract_PriceTier
definitions.description:
A price tier that applies until the mint count reaches `until_count`.
Tiers must be sorted ascending by `until_count`.
Example: [{ until_count: 100, price: 1_000_000utoken }, { until_count: 500, price: 5_000_000utoken }]
means: first 100 mints cost 1 token, mints 101-500 cost 5 tokens.

price.description: Price per token in this tier

until_count.description: This tier applies while mint_count < until_count

admin.description: admin who can run migrations (if any)

ibc2_port.description: set if this contract has bound an Ibc2 port

pinned.description: if set, the contract is pinned to the cache, and thus uses less gas when called
